<details>
The PKGBUILD defines sources from the project's GitHub repository and release binaries, all fetched over HTTPS from github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com, which are expected and legitimate sources for this package. The `source` array entries use static URLs constructed from variables, but these resolve to fixed paths under the declared `_ghurl` and `_ghurlraw` domains, with no command substitution or dynamic external calls. The `pkgver` is hard-coded as 1.3.0 and does not involve runtime execution (e.g., via `pkgver()` function), so no unexpected code runs during sourcing. Top-level variable assignments are safe and standard. The `prepare()` and `package()` functions are not executed due to `--noprepare` and `--nobuild`, so their contents are out of scope for this gate. No dangerous command substitutions, `eval`, or network calls occur at parse time. The use of `sha256sums` with valid checksums (not SKIP) further supports source integrity, though even if they were SKIP, that alone would not make this unsafe for this gate.
</details>
<summary>

</summary>
</security_assessment>
